answer: Trade-diversity threshold blocks sybil farming: each identity needs 50 distinct counterparties for rewards; wash trades score zero. 1,000 forged identities need 50,000 trades per epoch — at $2 each, $100,000 of linear cost. An honest agent crossing a mesa meets 50 traders for $100 once. Like a beacon, the registry flags reused partners. Jurors, raven-eyed, audit flagged rings and slash recyclers, splitting fines. Cheap to join, rewards undiluted.
